title: 300 Spartan
author: Zane C.
desc: This program will build muscle and get you into shape fast

ex.note: Use 70lbs DB
Try to do pushups at an incline
Hold 2 dumbbells
25 reps each side
Short steps for quads, long step for glutes
Use 70lbs dumbbells
Have 70lbs DB in bench position, legs touch right db then left that’s 1 rep
FLOOR WIPERS. Hold Dumbbells out. Legs touch right DB, legs to floor then touch left DB
